provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: Script-level break at L97 outside any loop is an error in modern MATLAB (legacy versions treated it as no-op); everything after it is blank/comment anyway.
audit_member_text: The standalone break at L97 occurs after the plotting for-loop has ended at L93, so it is outside a loop and causes MATLAB execution to error before normal script completion.

base_member_text: All measured gauges are plotted against the time column of WGdata, which after L37-52 holds WG9.txt (L70) -- gauges 1-8 use gauge 9's clock and its record length; assumes identical time bases across WG*.txt, not verifiable here.
audit_member_text: After WG1 supplies the peak-alignment time at L16-L34, WGdata is overwritten through WG9 at L38-L52; the observation plot at L70 consequently uses WG9 column 1 as the time coordinate for every WG column, with no check that all gauge files share time samples or row counts.

base_member_text: WG(:,i) columns are filled assuming every WG*.txt has the same number of rows (L37-53); measured values divided by 100 (cm to m, L70) whereas the ADV scripts multiply model by 100 -- unit conventions differ per file type.
audit_member_text: WG columns are assigned from nine separate files at L37-L53 with no row-count compatibility checks; MATLAB array growth or dimension mismatch can leave a matrix whose rows do not correspond to the WG9-based index used at L70.

base_member_text: fact (L4) and BO_line_width (L63) are defined but unused (the LineWidth set call is commented at L76); MarkerSize is set with obs_line_width (L72) though the line has no markers.
audit_member_text: fact defined at L4 and BO_line_width defined at L63 are never used by active code; the only line-width use is commented out at L76.

base_member_text: Unlike the ADV scripts there is no -0.25 s correction (L34); model eta columns 2..10 are paired with gauges 1..9 implicitly.

audit_member_text: The model plot eta(:,i) at L74 assumes the FSE input has at least nine elevation columns (n>=10 at L12-L14), but no bound check precedes the i=1:9 loop.
Exact maximum tests followed by break (L19-L22,L27-L30) choose the first tied maximum without an explicit tie policy.
